Health/PostgresCdcHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.unit: Unit tests construct the real PostgresCdcHealthCheck and run CheckHealthAsync against substituted connector and position store for the healthy, connector-failure (error code only in the data) and position-store-failure (degraded) branches, covering all three lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert ArgumentNullException for the null connector and position store, which the base CdcHealthCheck constructor throws; they run the constructor but not the health check body, so two of the three coverable lines.

PostgresCdcConnector.cs.reason: CDC connector over PostgreSQL logical replication. Unit tests run the paths that need no server (constructor guards, ConnectorId, failure paths against a refused local port, cancellation, position restore); the integration tests run the rest against a PostgreSQL container started with wal_level=logical (tests/Encina.IntegrationTests/Cdc/PostgreSql).

justifications.unit: Unit tests run the constructor guards, ConnectorId, the GetCurrentPositionAsync failure path and cancellation against a refused local port, and the StreamChangesAsync position-restore and publication-failure branches; the Npgsql replication messages have no public constructors, so the replication loop, message mapping, tuple reading and slot creation are only reachable with a live server (about 71 percent of the 183 coverable lines), and are measured by the integration flag.
justifications.integration: Integration tests run the real connector against a PostgreSQL 17 container with wal_level=logical: GetCurrentPositionAsync, fresh and pre-existing slot and publication, insert, delete and default-identity update events, truncate skipping, restoring a saved position, cancellation and the publication failure; left uncovered are the update-with-old-image mapping (its test is skipped because of a connector defect tracked in a follow-up issue), the null LSN branch and the generic catch blocks.

PostgresCdcOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults — no guard clauses

justifications.unit: Unit tests read every default and setter of the options POCO and its ToString, which covers all seven lines.

PostgresCdcPosition.cs.reason: Position with ToBytes/FromBytes serialization round-trip invariant and CompareTo antisymmetry

justifications.unit: Unit tests run the real PostgresCdcPosition constructor, ToBytes, FromBytes, CompareTo and ToString including the invalid-length and non-Postgres comparison branches, covering all twenty coverable lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert ArgumentNullException and ArgumentException on FromBytes and CompareTo; they reach only the guard lines of those two methods, three of the twenty coverable lines.
justifications.property: Property tests run the ToBytes/FromBytes round trip and CompareTo antisymmetry over random LSNs, leaving uncovered the guard-throwing branches and ToString.

justifications.unit: Unit tests call AddEncinaCdcPostgreSql with real service collections and resolve the registered options, connector and health check, covering all nine coverable lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert the ArgumentNullException for a null services collection and a null configure action, which is two of the nine coverable lines.
